purpose: Stage Two cycle 1: Codex and Claude alternate six artifact-producing turns on the pinned inquiry workbench. Each answer's mechanisms, adversarial cases and tests are scored in a sandbox before the other agent reads it; two non-progress turns in a row stop the cycle. At most six calls.

seed.title: FindPitches: which mechanism should decide what Mycelium explores next, and what evidence would show it beats a fixed crawl?
seed.body: Mycelium must keep finding UK vendor pitches (markets, fairs, events) that are real, open to applications now and actionable, while sources change, reopen, mislead or go quiet. This seed asks a question; it asserts nothing. Candidate mechanisms (a frontier bandit, competing predictive models, learned graph transformations, or something new) are compared on a pinned offline workbench against a fixed crawl with a watch list. Contributions should report what an artifact changed in that evidence and what result would refute the claim.
